title: valeriana excelsa subsp. sambucifolia
intro: Valeriana excelsa subsp. sambucifolia, commonly known as  the Himalayan or Himalayan Sweet-scented Valerian, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as improving sleep quality, reducing anxiety and stress, and acting as a natural sedative. The therapeutic actions of Valeriana excelsa subsp. sambucifolia include its anxiolytic, sedative, and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been attributed to its ability to interact with the neurotransmitters in the brain and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include valepotriates, valerenic acid, and isovaleric acid, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
